review_scope: Full430-line pinned implementation read; no code executed. Call sites and platform capability evidence remain open.

claims.statement: Ruleset retrieval includes inherited rulesets but selects at most 25 rule sets and 30 rules per set without cursors. Completeness is not established.
Transport, decoding, GraphQL errors and absent repository data collapse to nil; callers must not interpret that as verified absence or a passing requirement.
Batch query repeats the bounded rule selection and omits branch-selection conditions and bypass actors.
Projection labels a supplied branch but considers every active branch-targeting ruleset without testing its include/exclude conditions against that branch.
Projection combines the greatest review quorum, true review/check flags and a union of contexts across selected rules; it does not preserve effective scope, exceptions or bypass identity.
Protection is declared from the count of active branch-targeting rulesets, not proof that the assessed branch is covered or that writes were rejected.
REST fallback is an inert skeleton returning nil, not an available adapter.
